integrity: All public documents give the same five-path-free multipartite theorem and do not assert external certification.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary integral homotopy only; no automorphism module, equivariant wedge, or general paths of length six and above. Finite checks do not substitute for unrestricted chain proof. Potential unindexed equivalent literature remains an originality risk.
title: Five-path-free complexes of complete multipartite graphs are wedges of three-spheres
